_approach: The tribal/Balearic-adjacent branch of uplifting trance: congas and shaker carry a syncopated call-and-response over the standard 909 kick and offbeat open hat, closed hats thinned right back so the percussion reads clearly — the 'more organic' groove layer some 2000s trance productions add under the main hat pattern rather than replacing it. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
